Manage real-time streaming data subscriptions via WebSocket

Makes the Bloomberg Open API available via HTTP and WebSockets, allowing clients to access reference and historical request-response data as well as subscribe to live streaming market data. This API wraps the BLPAPI protocol into RESTful HTTP endpoints and WebSocket connections.
